items.title: Masle ko chhote hisson mein torna (Decomposition) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Breaking a Problem into Smaller Parts (Decomposition) (printed page 21, read from a second copy of the book; not in this scan).

blocks.text: Masle ko chhote hisson mein torna decomposition (tor phor kar hisse banana) kehlata hai. Bara masla aik dafa mein hal karna mushkil ho sakta hai. Chhote hisse samajhna aur sambhalna (manage karna) aasan hota hai. Har hissa step by step hal kiya ja sakta hai. Is se uljhan (confusion) aur pareshani (stress) kam hoti hai. Decomposition hamare khayalat ko tarteeb (organize) deti hai. Is se hum aik waqt mein aik hi kaam par dhyan de sakte hain. Yeh tareeqa computer science aur rozmarra ke kaamon mein aam istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Misal: school ka annual function. Poora function aik saath sochna mushkil hai, magar hisson mein aasan hai: stage sajana, program ki list banana, mehmanon ko da'wat dena, sound system lagana, refreshment. Har hissa alag group sambhal leta hai aur sab mil kar function mukammal ho jata hai. Computer program bhi isi tarah chhote functions mein toda jata hai.

blocks.prompt: 'Birthday party ka intezam' ko decomposition se kam az kam chaar hisson mein torein.
blocks.explanation: Mehmanon ki list aur da'wat, cake aur khane ka intezam, kamra sajana, aur khel ya activities ki planning. Har hissa alag se aur aik waqt mein aik kar ke kiya ja sakta hai.

items: Decomposition: bare masle ko chhote hisson mein torna.
Chhote hisse samajhne aur sambhalne mein aasan; har hissa step by step hal hota hai.
Uljhan aur stress kam; aik waqt mein aik kaam par dhyan.
